intent: Implement the supplied voice latency audit follow-up: genuine incremental PCM engines, verified model installation and selection, selected-rate CPU calibration, continuity-aware chunks, safe early preparation, bounded profile parsing and Gateway binary audio streaming. Compose the separately owned accelerator output qualification, memory-aware exact-shape cache and complete benchmark evidence before final verification and joint publication.
acceptance: Preserve current native Kokoro and privacy/admission behavior while adding real MediaPipe 1.2.3 Kokoro, Phonon and Pocket adapters using immutable model revisions, byte lengths and SHA-256 verification.
Queue incremental PCM as it arrives with bounded backpressure, explicit native cancellation, correctly converted estimated word cues and no fabricated native phoneme timings or provider proof.
Calibrate native CPU with the selected voice/rate, balanced 1-4 thread candidates, cancellation and thermal guards; adapt follow-up chunks to observed synthesis cost and buffered audio.
Prepare local speech after a completed spoken turn and before admission completes while retaining recognition teardown, privacy and warmup-generation fences; keep remote preparation admission-gated.
Offer compatible bounded binary Gateway streaming while retaining the existing JSON endpoint and validating framing, cancellation and privacy.
Preserve every concurrent branch commit and reservation; qualify the final immutable PR and actual main source without bypassing required checks.
Verify predecessor publication before successor merge and verify public Android and Gateway release assets before completion.
